author: Cortex

agentixaction.description: Extract rendered content from web pages using Chrome browser automation. Navigates to each URL, waits for full page rendering, and extracts clean text content while preserving structure and converting links to markdown format. Note: This action does not bypass Cloudflare or other anti-bot protections. if a page is protected, extraction may fail for that URL and an alternative web content retrieval action should be used for it.
agentixaction.name: ExtractURLContent

readme:
During incident investigation you can enhance the investigation with screenshots of URLS or with emails and other PDF files.  
**Note:**  
This content pack is installed by default when Cortex is initially deployed.  

## What Does This Pack Do?  

Converts URLs, PDF files, and emails to an image file or a PDF file.
